<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Stubborn Defiance](/Feats.aspx?ID=5336) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 33

</column>

---

You're brave and stubborn and refuse to back down or bow to the wishes of another. You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effects. Additionally, you gain the I Defy You! reaction.

 **I Defy You!** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=612), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Trigger** You fail a save against a [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effect; **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** You reroll the triggering save and must take the second result.
name: Stubborn Defiance
